Name: Pekah, Son of Remaliah
Summary: Pekah, son of Remaliah, slew a hundred and twenty thousand valiant men of Judah in one day because they had forsaken the LORD, and carried away two hundred thousand captives to Samaria.
KeyStory: Pekah's slaughter of Judah was answered by Oded's rebuke, and the captives were clothed, fed and returned to Jericho.
RelatedPeople: Ahaz, King of Judah; Oded, Prophet of Samaria
LifeLesson: Victory won in rage against brethren invites God's rebuke, not His blessing.
